messages:
Marta (CS): Drafting a compact customer-facing "pilot landing check" — one-page share for go-live that covers caching, batching, streaming, basic telemetry rules for renewal risk, and an emergency ladder. Quick review please.

Ethan (Infra): Love a one-pager. Can we include an adaptive batch recommendation (start conservative, then increase after 72h telemetry)? Suggest sample thresholds.

Marta (CS): Proposed customer copy (3 bullets + small examples):
1) Quick pre-go-live checks: confirm token budget & p95 latency target (example: 5k tokens/day per seat; p95 < 1s).
2) Caching: enable route cache with TTL=60s. Use key tenant|route|prompt_prefix to keep hits high.
3) UX: enable streaming for any user-facing chat/search flows so partial responses show immediately.

Kai (SRE): Warm pools: advise a fuzzy public recommendation: "start with a few warm workers per ~10 active tenants; we'll provide sizing ranges in the onboarding packet." Internal note: use jitter 0-30s. Share readiness probe snippet customers can paste:
```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
```
Add circuit-breaker example for non-essential routes: reject when queue_depth > 200 and error_rate > 0.5%.

Ethan (Infra): Adaptive batching suggestion for customers to copy/paste into SDK guidance: start with window=50ms or max 8 reqs; if 72h median latency < 600ms and error rate <0.3%, increase to 100ms or 16 reqs to save cost. Pseudo: 
```js
// SDK batcher: adaptive window
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), batcher.window)
if (batch.length >= batcher.max) batcher.flush()
// control-plane can adjust batcher.window after 72h metrics
```
Also call out token-budget baseline and iterate with telemetry.

Pri (PM): Renewal-risk signals to surface in dashboards (keep simple):
- Usage: 7d MAU down >=35% -> CS outreach + trial re-engagement.
- QoE: sustained p95 latency >1.8x baseline for 48h -> escalate to SRE + enable streaming/fallback routing.
- Reliability: error rate >1% with >=1 open ticket -> bridgecall + priority remediation.
Mitigation ladder (short): prefetch top prompts, enable route-cache warmup, temporary model downgrade for non-critical routes, add token credits if SLA impacted.

Marta (CS): Short customer email snippet to copy into onboarding: "Before go-live: set token budget, enable route cache (60s), and enable streaming for end-user flows. Our team will monitor the first 72 hours and recommend batching and warm-pool adjustments."

Kai (SRE): Add a tiny Prometheus alert example we can optionally share with customers' infra teams:
```
- alert: HighLatencyPilot
  expr: job:request_latency_p95:rate5m > 1.8 * baseline_p95
  for: 30m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

runbot: Runbook created: cs/pilot-landing-check-v1 (internal) :page_facing_up:

Marta (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll make a polished one-pager for the onboarding email (public) and a slightly expanded internal checklist with exact warm-pool sizing and adaptive-batcher knobs. Will drop both in #cs-docs by EOD. :thumbsup:
